method.source: The ledger's approved Commons file for each player (<=2560 px rendition), identity and rights as reviewed in data/player-photos.json.
method.framing: Reviewed face box from the ledger; eye line at 40% of the box; head = face +45% up +10% headroom, always fully inside the frame (stage-6 rules). Never upscaled beyond 1.3x: larger sizes are omitted, not blown up.
method.treatment: Subject sharp in the foreground; the rest of the photo defocused and dimmed, and every other detected face (YuNet) held out of the sharp zone so only the pictured player is in focus; frame areas outside the photo filled with a defocused, dimmed, team-tinted cover of the same photo. No top-centre crops, no stretching.
method.credit: Every slot carries the ledger attribution; og.jpg prints it on the image.
